title: Unit 24 Consolidation

items: Review llevar, seguir, ir, andar and venir with a gerund.
Review seguir sin and the difference between ir, andar and venir.
Read a retelling of the first part of Roberto Arlt's novel El juguete rabioso.
I can tell llevar, seguir, ir, andar and venir with a gerund apart.
I can say how long something has been going on and that it is still going on.
I can read a short retelling of the first part of Roberto Arlt's novel El juguete rabioso.
sections.title: Can you do this?

goal: Review llevar, seguir, ir, andar and venir with a gerund, and read a retelling of the first part of El juguete rabioso.
